notes:
Torrents: paste a magnet link or open a .torrent file (File, Add torrent file) and it downloads in the same list, with pause, resume, speed limits and queues.
Torrents need no firewall permission: Stupefy only connects out to peers, and uploads only while a torrent is downloading.
Browser extension 0.5.0: right-click a magnet link to send it to Stupefy.
Settings, Network: upload limit for torrents, and an option to open magnet links and .torrent files with Stupefy.
The installer's "Installed apps" entry now links to the right website.
